Gulf Shores Salon & Spa Services
Serving Clients in Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, Foley, Perdido Key & Other Areas
You are here:
HomeServices
Haircut & Hair Color

No client has the same style. Our talented stylists customize the hairstyle, haircut, and hair color to the beautiful customers we serve. Our team has over 50 years of combined experience offering women’s cuts, men’s cuts, color, perms, extensions, and Brazilian blowouts to clients in Orange Beach, Foley, Perdido, and Gulf Shores.

Manicures & Pedicures

Let us make your nails beautiful with relaxing manicures and pedicures. Our talented nail technicians provide a unique and relaxing experience complete with a consultation that helps you achieve and maintain the perfect look. We offer acrylic nails, gel nails, and shellac polish as well as other services to enhance your natural nails. Give us a call or book online to schedule your appointment.

Waxing

Hair can often seem like a blessing and a curse. Harmful chemicals often burn skin resulting in redness and irritation while shaving and trimming are temporary solutions that only cut hair on the surface, leaving the root intact.

Our waxing professionals use warm wax to remove hair from the root, leaving you smooth and hairless for weeks not days. At CC’s, we strive to provide a judgment-free environment that uses hygienic, effective, and comfortable techniques. We offer waxing for brows, lips, chin, full face, bikini, Brazilian, half legs, full legs, back, underarms, and arms.

Call us if you have questions about scheduling, preparation, our waxing process, or aftercare.

Massage & Spa Packages

Our experienced, professional massage therapists personalize each massage to meet every client’s needs with the goal of improving their overall wellness. CC’s offers a variety of massage types and time options at 30, 60, and 90-minute intervals including: relaxation, hot stone, deep tissue/Swedish, reiki, and neck, back, and shoulder. Couples massages are available upon request and based on availability.

You can also select from spa package options to help you sit back, relax, and unwind.

Facials & Skincare

Put your best face forward and love the skin you’re in! Our relaxing facial treatments will leave you refreshed and glowing inside and out. We use organic skincare products that stimulate blood flow and improve the flow of oxygen to your skin and surrounding tissue. At CC’s, we only use high-quality products that maintain healthy, youthful, and radiant skin.

Book a consultation with one of our salon professionals to see how we can help you with your skincare!

Professional Makeup

Makeup should enhance a woman’s natural beauty – not hide it! At CC’s, we help clients put a ‘finishing touch’ on their look while being careful to preserve and respect their personal style. Our team doesn’t do over-the-top makeovers but instead strives to provide beautiful, subtle enhancements. We offer mineral makeup, airbrush makeup, eyelash extensions (placement & fills), and eyelash strip applications.

Our services can be customized for date nights, prom, weddings, or any special occasion.

Weddings & Special Events

Our team of experienced stylists, makeup artists, and nail technicians can handle all of your wedding day and special event beauty needs! Our packages are customized to your specific needs and preferences. We offer haircuts, hair color, hair design, facials, manicures, pedicures, massage, and professional makeup services for the entire bridal party. Let CC’s Salon, Day Spa & Boutique take the stress out of your wedding or special event to give you the relaxing and memorable experience you deserve. Call (251) 968-2077 for quotes and more information.

Our team is also available to serve your bridal party before the dress rehearsal and on your wedding day at our salon or on-site (additional on-site fees apply). We are excited to help you celebrate your special day!

Microblading

Reclaim your time spent drawing and maintaining beautiful brows with microblading, a semi-permanent eyebrow enhancement technique. Microblading allows you to create your desired eyebrow shape, fullness, and color by inserting pigment into the outer layers of the skin. Our experienced technicians work with you to produce custom, fuller brows that last between one and three years, depending on a variety of factors. Touch-ups are often needed about once a year, especially for those with oily skin.

Call today for more info or to book your appointment!

Eyelash Extensions

A look isn’t complete without some lash love! Our technicians offer several eyelash extension options. We can apply individual lashes to enhance your natural look or to make up for lashes that have been lost in the natural shedding process. We also offer temporary lash strips for special occasions.

Call today for more info or to book your appointment!

Cryotherapy

Cryotherapy, or “cold therapy,” is a therapy that involves localized freezing temperatures for several minutes at a time. Cryotherapy has been proven to have several health benefits including aiding in pain management, weight loss, skin conditions, migraines, anxiety and depression, cancer prevention and muscle relaxation.

Call today for more info or to book your cryotherapy appointment at our gulf shores salon and spa!

Gulf Shores Hair Color Trends: Shadow Root & More

Hair Color Trends: Shadow Roots, Balayage & More
Are you ready to change up your look? Check out these top hair color trends in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, Alabama. Whether you prefer something subtle or want to go bold, the hair color specialists at our Gulf Shores salon will help you find the best style to suit your tastes. Learn more about trending techniques including shadow roots, balayage, traditional highlights, baby lowlights and ombre.
Shadow Roots
GULF SHORES SALON HAIR COLOR TREND #1

Shadow roots are one of the hottest trends in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, Alabama, not to mention budget-friendly and easy to maintain!

Also known as “root smudge,” this technique fades fresh color into your natural roots and creates the illusion of your roots casting a shadow on the rest of your hair.
Root shadowing adds subtle contrast and dimension to your look, which can also make your hair appear more full and voluminous.
This hair trend extends the life of your color and requires fewer root touch-ups, so you save money on trips to the salon.
Shadow roots are a low-maintenance style that is easy to grow out, which is perfect if you want longer locks.
Color options are endless, so shadow roots are suitable for anyone!
Balayage
GULF SHORES SALON HAIR COLOR TREND #2

Balayage creates natural-looking highlights that add pops of brightness and contrast throughout your hair.

Balayage is a French word meaning “to sweep.” These hand-painted highlights are “swept” onto the surface of the hair.
Unlike traditional highlights, balayage does not require the use of foils, which means the process is quicker.
Balayage highlights blend seamlessly into your natural color, making them easy to maintain.
This technique adds beautiful dimension with color that is typically just a few shades lighter than your natural hair.
This style is perfect if you want a natural sun-kissed glow that looks like you just came from the beach!
Highlights
GULF SHORES SALON HAIR COLOR TREND #3

Lighten your locks with traditional highlights for amazing depth and dimension, and get ready for summer in Gulf Shores!

Traditional highlights are obtained by separating pieces of hair into foils and adding color from root to tip.
Distinct lines of color are woven through the hair, resulting in bold, bright strands.
Foil highlights require fewer touch-ups than a full dye, but more than balayage highlights.
Full highlights cover the whole head, while partial highlights are placed strategically on top sections or around the face.
If you’re looking for an all-over lighter look, traditional highlights may be the best choice for you.
Cute Baby Lowlights
GULF SHORES SALON HAIR COLOR TREND #4

If you want to darken your look oh, so slightly, baby lowlights might be the style for you. Visit our Orange Beach stylists today!

Baby lowlights are delicate strands of color that are darker than your natural hair.
Using a traditional foiling method, dye is applied to sections of hair, creating deeper tones and depth.
Lowlights allow you to darken your look and add dimension without committing to a drastic change.
Lowlights can give the illusion of thicker, voluminous hair, so they work particularly well for clients with fine hair.
Baby lowlights are achieved by coloring micro-strands of hair, creating a more subtle look than that of traditional lowlights.
Ombre
GULF SHORES SALON HAIR COLOR TREND #5

Ombre is a dramatic color effect that is low maintenance and can work on anyone. Our Gulf Shores stylists are ready to show you how!

Meaning “to shade,” this hair color trend is a seamless graduation from dark roots to light tips.
Ombre is similar to balayage, except that ombre results in a bolder look with more saturated color.
This style is easy to maintain and easy to grow out, thanks to the gradual gradation of color.
Ombre hairstyles can be any color combination, from natural blonde, brown or red to something more unconventional.
A more subtle variation of ombre is called sombre, which features a lesser contrast between light and dark shades.

Hair can often seem like a blessing and a curse. Harmful chemicals often burn skin resulting in redness and irritation while shaving and trimming are temporary solutions that only cut hair on the surface, leaving the root intact.

Our waxing professionals use warm wax to remove hair from the root, leaving you smooth and hairless for weeks not days. At CC’s, we strive to provide a judgment-free environment that uses hygienic, effective, and comfortable techniques. We offer waxing for brows, lips, chin, full face, bikini, Brazilian, half legs, full legs, back, underarms, and arms.

Call us if you have questions about scheduling, preparation, our waxing process, or aftercare.
